cover_note: IMALPAL unisce IMAL, PAL e GLOBUS e realizza macchine su misura e impianti completi per pannelli in legno e riciclo con sedi nel Nord Italia. Qui trova come lavoriamo e cosa potremmo fare per IMAL.

evidence.claim: IMALPAL unisce IMAL, PAL e GLOBUS e realizza macchine su misura e impianti completi per pannelli in legno e riciclo con sedi nel Nord Italia.
evidence.quote: Bringing together the expertise of IMAL, PAL and GLOBUS, the IMALPAL Group provides engineering, customized wood processing machinery and complete plants for the wood-based panel and recycling industries. || The Group is the union of three major companies: IMAL, PAL, and GLOBUS, which have been joined by other companies over the years, through mergers and acquisitions, with production sites and offices throughout Northern Italy. || customized wood processing machinery and complete plants for the wood-based panel and recycling industries
